answer: Cosignatures are collected in plume, verified in lantern, and thread names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 44 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Repeating the trick 22 times costs 10 separate deposits and 6 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
